--- schema
CREATE TABLE streams (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    slug  TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE TABLE books (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL,
    author      TEXT,
    url         TEXT,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE institutes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    city        TEXT,
    website     TEXT,
    description TEXT
, source_id TEXT, district TEXT, state TEXT);
CREATE TABLE job_sectors (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE node_books (
    node_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    book_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, book_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_institutes (
    node_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, institute_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_job_sectors (
    node_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    job_sector_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES job_sectors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, job_sector_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "career_nodes" (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    slug      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    stream_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES "career_nodes"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name      TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro     TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_books_title ON books(title);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_name ON institutes(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_job_sectors_name ON job_sectors(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_source_id
            ON institutes(source_id)
            WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_location
            ON institutes(state, district, city);
CREATE TABLE institute_courses (
            id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            source_id           TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            institute_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                                    REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                    ON DELETE CASCADE,
            name                TEXT NOT NULL,
            level               TEXT NOT NULL,
            credential          TEXT,
            specialization      TEXT,
            duration            TEXT,
            mode                TEXT,
            eligibility         TEXT,
            official_course_url TEXT NOT NULL,
            verification_status TEXT NOT NULL
        , mapping_gap TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_courses_institute
            ON institute_courses(institute_id);
CREATE TABLE course_career_nodes (
            course_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES institute_courses(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            node_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES career_nodes(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            relation       TEXT NOT NULL,
            confidence     TEXT NOT NULL,
            mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (course_id, node_id)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_course_career_nodes_node
            ON course_career_nodes(node_id);
CREATE TABLE institute_categories (
            institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL
                             REFERENCES institutes(id)
                             ON DELETE CASCADE,
            category     TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, category)
        );
CREATE TABLE institute_rankings (
            institute_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                                  REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                  ON DELETE CASCADE,
            system            TEXT NOT NULL,
            year              INTEGER NOT NULL,
            category          TEXT NOT NULL,
            nirf_institute_id TEXT,
            rank              INTEGER,
            rank_band         TEXT,
            score             REAL,
            source_url        TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, system, year, category)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_rankings_order
            ON institute_rankings(year, category, rank, rank_band);

The Samiti laid the foundation stone of Agrawal Senior Secondary School in July, 1918. In 1954, it was transformed into Agrawal Inter College. In short span of seven years, the Inter College was certified as a degree college with all the three streams; Science, Arts and Commerce in 1957, 1959 and 1961, respectively. The college is situated in the heart of city at Agrasen Katla, Maharaja Agrasen Marg, Agra Road, Jaipur. Being  the oldest  and  leading  college  of  the  city, it attracts students from all over India. The college is well connected with other parts of city by the public transport. About 50,000 sq. yards college campus is surrounded by sprawling lawns and gardens. A well maintained botanical garden and nursery protects the biodiversity of  the area. The institute has enhanced its scope of education by providing more specialized and professional courses . APGC is the first college of Rajasthan who has got affiliation from RISU to provide dual degree courses. In dual  degree programs, with UG courses and PG courses it also provides skill development courses to enable students to seek better career opportunities in this competitive world. The college is committed to educate its students to be reflective and resourceful individuals ready to live, adapt, and lead in an interconnected world. Apart  from  the  dual  degree  programs  college offers  various  certificate courses to groom the students  personality. The Institute through its experienced and qualified faculty continually innovates education to ensure that we meet the needs of students and an ever-changing world. These are only a few attributes that make  our campus a place that fosters personal and academic growth. Shri Agrawal Shiksha Samiti Shri Agrawal Shiksha Samiti, a pioneer society since 1918 with a deep commitment for quality education, is providing education from primary level to higher education in the heart of the Pink City Jaipur. The mission of the society is to educate a diverse student body to become responsible global citizen and future leaders through a challenging learning environment.
